Compare NYGC DEGs to Pineda snRNA-seq DEGs

BA4 - MCX
BA9 - FCX


```{r}
nygc <- readxl::read_excel("~/Downloads/ST4_updated.xlsx")
nygc_cc <-  readxl::read_excel("../../Manuscripts/NYGC_Flagship/Figures/Review Response/Tables/combined_DEG_supp_tables_review.xlsx", sheet = "ST18-DEG_cell_types_corrected")

names(nygc)[1] <- "gene_id"
names(nygc)[2] <- "gene_symbol"
nygc$gene_id <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+", "", nygc$gene_id)

# Ali omits gene symbols for non-coding RNAs - fix this somehow
nygc_mcx <- select(nygc, gene_id, gene.nygc = gene_symbol, starts_with("MCX")) %>% drop_na()
nygc_fcx <- select(nygc, gene_id, gene.nygc = gene_symbol, starts_with("FCX")) %>% drop_na()

names(nygc_mcx) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "lfc", "pvalue", "padj")
names(nygc_fcx) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "lfc", "pvalue", "padj")

# cell-type corrected
names(nygc_cc)[1] <- "gene_id"
names(nygc_cc)[2] <- "gene_symbol"

nygc_cc$gene_id <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+", "", nygc_cc$gene_id)

nygc_mcx_cc <- select(nygc_cc, gene_id, gene.nygc = gene_symbol, starts_with("MCX")) %>% drop_na()
nygc_fcx_cc <- select(nygc_cc, gene_id, gene.nygc = gene_symbol, starts_with("FCX")) %>% drop_na()

names(nygc_mcx_cc) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "lfc", "pvalue", "padj")
names(nygc_fcx_cc) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "lfc", "pvalue", "padj")

test <- inner_join(nygc_fcx, nygc_fcx_cc, by = c("gene_id", "gene_name"), suffix = c(".norm", ".cc") )
ggplot(test, aes(x = lfc.norm, y = lfc.cc)) + geom_point() + xlim(-2,2) + ylim(-2,2)
table(test$padj.cc < 0.05)
table(test$padj.norm < 0.05)
cc_genes <- filter(test, padj.cc < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id)
norm_genes <- filter(test, padj.norm < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id)
length(intersect(cc_genes, norm_genes))


make_file_list <- function(file){
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)
  data.frame(file = rep(file, length(sheets) ), sheet = sheets)
}

pineda_files <- c("MAP4K4/Pineda/4_1_deg_res_BA4_SALS.xlsx", "MAP4K4/Pineda/4_5_deg_res_BA9_SALS.xlsx", "MAP4K4/Pineda/6_1_deg_res_BA4_SALS.xlsx", "MAP4K4/Pineda/6_5_deg_res_BA9_SALS.xlsx") 

pineda_df <- map_df(pineda_files, make_file_list) %>%
  mutate(tissue = case_when(
    grepl("BA4", file) ~ "MCX",
    grepl("BA9", file) ~ "FCX"
  ))
pineda_df$set <- paste0(pineda_df$tissue, ":", pineda_df$sheet)


# for each sheet in each file
# read in sheet
# join with NYGC MCX or FCX
# count shared up and down genes
# do correlation with and without shared genes

compare_res <- map(1:nrow(pineda_df), ~{
  d <- pineda_df[.x,]
  df <- readxl::read_excel(d$file, sheet = d$sheet)
  names(df) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "chr", "biotype", "lfc", "ave_expr", "t", "pvalue", "padj", "b")
  
  mcx_merge <- inner_join(nygc_mcx, df, by = "gene_id", suffix = c(".nygc", ".pin") ) %>% mutate(cell_type = d$sheet, tissue = d$tissue)
  fcx_merge <- inner_join(nygc_fcx, df, by = "gene_id", suffix = c(".nygc", ".pin") ) %>% mutate(cell_type = d$sheet, tissue = d$tissue)
  
   mcx_cc_merge <- inner_join(nygc_mcx_cc, df, by = "gene_id", suffix = c(".nygc", ".pin") ) %>% mutate(cell_type = d$sheet, tissue = d$tissue)
  fcx_cc_merge <- inner_join(nygc_fcx_cc, df, by = "gene_id", suffix = c(".nygc", ".pin") ) %>% mutate(cell_type = d$sheet, tissue = d$tissue)
  
  return(list(mcx = mcx_merge, fcx = fcx_merge, mcx_cc = mcx_cc_merge, fcx_cc = fcx_cc_merge))
} )

names(compare_res) <- pineda_df$set

#d <- res$`MCX:Ex`$mcx
calc_concord <- function(d, group){
  d <- filter(d, padj.nygc < 0.05)
  n_gene <- nrow(d)
  #sig_both <- filter(d, padj.nygc < 0.05)
  #n_sig <- nrow(sig_both)
  cor_all <- cor.test(d$lfc.nygc, d$lfc.pin, method = "spearman")
  #cor_sig <- cor.test(sig_both$lfc.nygc, sig_both$lfc.pin, method = "spearman" )
  r_all <- cor_all$estimate
  p_all <- cor_all$p.value
  #r_sig <- cor_sig$estimate
  #p_sig <- cor_sig$p.value
  n_concordant <- filter(d, sign(lfc.nygc) == sign(lfc.pin)) %>% nrow()
  prop_concordant <- n_concordant / n_gene
  data.frame(group, n_gene, r_all, p_all, n_concordant, prop_concordant) %>% as_tibble()
}

cor_res <- map_df(compare_res, ~{
  mcx <- .x$mcx
  fcx <- .x$fcx
  mcx_cc <- .x$mcx_cc
  fcx_cc <- .x$fcx_cc
  
  bind_rows( calc_concord(mcx, "MCX"), calc_concord(fcx, "FCX"),calc_concord(mcx_cc, "MCX_cc"), calc_concord(fcx_cc, "FCX_cc") )
  
}, .id = "set")

cor_res <- separate(cor_res, set, into = c("pineda_tissue", "cell_type"), sep = ":")

cor_res$cell_group <- gsub("\\..*", "", cor_res$cell_type)

names(cor_res)[3] <- "bulk_tissue"

out_df <- filter(cor_res, pineda_tissue == bulk_tissue)

cor_res$deg_type <- ifelse(grepl("_cc", cor_res$bulk_tissue), "Corrected", "Standard")
cor_res$bulk <- gsub("_cc", "", cor_res$bulk_tissue)
```

```{r}
    "Vasc.Endo"               = "Endothelial",
    "Vasc.Mural.Pericyte"     = "Pericytes",

  )) %>%

  mutate(cell_type = gsub(".*\\.", "", cell_type)) %>%

library(ggrastr)
make_scatter <- function(data, tissue, cell, sub, test = "once"){

  df <- data %>%
  filter(padj.nygc < 0.05)# & padj.pin < 0.05)
  if(test == "both"){
    df <- filter(df, padj.pin < 0.05)
  }
  label_df <- group_by(df, lfc.pin > 0, lfc.nygc > 0) %>% tally()
  print(label_df)
  df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lfc.pin, y = lfc.nygc)) + 
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.75, colour = "black", shape = 21, aes(fill = padj.pin < 0.05)), dpi = 600)  + 
 # geom_density_2d(colour = "black") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") + theme_classic() +
  ylim(-1,1) + xlim(-0.5,0.5) + 
  geom_hline(linetype = 3, yintercept = 0) + geom_vline(linetype =3, xintercept = 0) +
  labs(x = "Pineda LFC", y = "NYGC LFC", title = paste0("Bulk ", tissue, " vs ", cell), subtitle = sub) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -0.4, y = -0.5, label = label_df$n[1]) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -0.4, y = 0.5, label = label_df$n[2] ) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.4, y = -0.5, label = label_df$n[3] ) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.4, y = 0.5, label = label_df$n[4] ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("yellow", "red"))
}
```

```{r}
clean_cell_label <- function(cell) {
  cell %>%
    gsub("^Ex$", "Excitatory neurons", .) %>%
    gsub("^In$", "Inhibitory neurons", .) %>%
    gsub("^Glia\\.Astro\\.GFAP-neg$", "Astrocytes (GFAP-)", .) %>%
    gsub("^Glia\\.Astro\\.GFAP-pos$", "Astrocytes (GFAP+)", .) %>%
    gsub("^Glia\\.Micro$", "Microglia", .) %>%
    gsub("^Glia\\.Oligo$", "Oligodendrocytes", .) %>%
    gsub("^Glia\\.OPC$", "OPC", .) %>%
    gsub("^Vasc\\.Endo$", "Endothelial", .) %>%
    gsub("^Vasc\\.Fibro$", "Fibroblasts", .) %>%
    gsub("^Vasc\\.Mural\\.Pericyte$", "Pericytes", .)
}

broad_cells <- c(
  "Ex", "In",
  "Glia.Astro.GFAP-neg", "Glia.Astro.GFAP-pos",
  "Glia.Micro", "Glia.Oligo", "Glia.OPC",
  "Vasc.Endo", "Vasc.Mural.Pericyte", "Vasc.Fibro"
)

tissues <- c("FCX", "MCX")

plot_list <- list()

for (cell in broad_cells) {
  for (tissue in tissues) {
    key <- paste0(tissue, ":", cell)
    tissue_lower <- tolower(tissue)
    cell_label <- clean_cell_label(cell)

    if (key %in% names(compare_res) &&
        tissue_lower %in% names(compare_res[[key]])) {
      p <- make_scatter(
        compare_res[[key]][[tissue_lower]],
        tissue,
        cell_label,
        "standard model"
      )
    } else {
      p <- ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = paste0("Bulk ", tissue, " vs ", cell_label),
             subtitle = "not available") +
        theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey60"),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey60"))
    }
    plot_list[[paste0(tissue, "_", cell)]] <- p
  }
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Bulk ALS DEGs vs Pineda et al. single-nucleus DEGs",
    subtitle = "Genes significant in bulk (FDR < 0.05); Spearman correlation",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  )

ggsave(
  "bulk_vs_snrnaseq_broad_classes.pdf",
  width     = 10,
  height    = length(broad_cells) * 3.5,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```
